# Talkspace Named to TIME’s World’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2026


Just a typical day in the office


Full length portrait of a diverse group of businesspeople standing together and using technology in the office during the day


**King of Prussia, PA (September 22, 2026)** —[Talkspace](https://www.talkspace.com/) , a UHS company, and[Wisdo Health](https://wisdo.com/) by Talkspace have been named to the World’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2026 list by TIME. The World’s Top HealthTech Companies 2026 list is the result of a comprehensive international analysis conducted to identify the most innovative and impactful health technology companies across the globe.


To identify the companies using digital technologies to make healthcare more effective and accessible, TIME partnered with data firm Statista to research the World’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2026, evaluating metrics including financial performance, reputation and online engagement.


[See the methodology and full list of recognized companies →](https://time.com/article/2026/09/16/worlds-top-healthtech-companies-2026/)
